purpose: Concision revision regression check on six unchanged v1 tasks
runs: Six fresh revised-skill sessions; original v1 skill answers reused only as historical comparisons, not new runs. No fresh no-skill baseline.
criteria: Original task criteria preserved for regression; also independently inspect factual count accuracy and give qualitative comments on first-action clarity and repeated material. Do not combine length with task quality into an improvement score.
limitations: Cases already seen during development; regression set, not held-out evidence
Inherited Codex session configuration; exact model ID not exposed
AI grading and coordinator AI review; no human validation
No evidence of time savings, general quality uplift or cross-model reliability
